newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 42-day CDs draw 14.15 pct avg yield at sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru 42-day CDs draw 14.15 pct avg yield at sale.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Thursday it accepted bids for 42-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 40.0 million soles at an effective average annual rate of 14.15 percent during a bank auction.
The CDs have a September 6 starting date.
The accepted bids had a minimum rate of 14.00 percent and a maximum rate 14.45 percent, the bank said.
On August 28, at the last auction, 28-day CDs drew an average yield of 14.76 pct percent.
At Thursday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 84.2 million soles.
The bank had offered 40.0 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
